import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 2e-3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8,
          "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.002, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.85}

# layout = (type_major, spatial_transposed, flip_y, flip_x)
LAYOUTS = [(True, False, False, False), (True, False, False, True),
           (True, False, True, False), (True, False, True, True),
           (True, True, False, False), (True, True, False, True),
           (True, True, True, False), (True, True, True, True),
           (False, False, False, False), (False, False, False, True),
           (False, False, True, False), (False, False, True, True),
           (False, True, False, False), (False, True, False, True),
           (False, True, True, False), (False, True, True, True)]
OFFSETS = [0]
OBS_VIEWS = ["id"]
HEAD_K = 3
STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
HEADC = 32
GLOB = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.n_actions = int(spec.n_actions)
        self.grid_ok = self.n_place == self.T * self.Y * self.X
        self.views = [v for v in OBS_VIEWS if v != "tr" or self.Y == self.X]
        if self.grid_ok:
            self.offsets = [o for o in OFFSETS if o + self.n_place <= self.n_actions]
        else:
            self.offsets = [0]
        self.n_maps = len(self.offsets) * len(LAYOUTS)
        if self.grid_ok:
            mask_ch = self.n_maps * self.T
        else:
            mask_ch = 8
            self.mask_embed = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, 8 * self.Y * self.X)
        in_ch = len(self.views) * self.C + mask_ch + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
                                  nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.r1 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.r2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        if HEAD_K == 3:
            self.hpre = nn.Identity()
            self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HEADC, 3, padding=1)
        else:
            self.hpre = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, 16, 1)
            self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(16, HEADC, HEAD_K, padding=HEAD_K // 2)
        self.hskip = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HEADC, 1)
        if self.grid_ok:
            self.hout = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, self.n_maps * self.T, 1)
        else:
            self.hout = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, 8, 1)
            self.fb_out = nn.Linear(8 * self.Y * self.X, self.n_place)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, len(self.offsets))
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        self.scale = min(1.0, 2.0 / (self.n_maps ** 0.5))

    def obs_views(self, obs):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        out = []
        for v in self.views:
            if v == "id":
                out.append(obs)
            elif v == "tr":
                out.append(obs.transpose(2, 3))
            elif v == "fy":
                out.append(obs.flip(2))
            elif v == "fx":
                out.append(obs.flip(3))
            elif v == "chl":
                out.append(obs.reshape(B, self.Y, self.X, self.C).permute(0, 3, 1, 2))
        return out

    def to_grid(self, v, lay):
        tmaj, tr, fy, fx = lay
        B = v.shape[0]
        T, Y, X = self.T, self.Y, self.X
        if tmaj:
            g = v.reshape(B, T, X, Y).transpose(2, 3) if tr else v.reshape(B, T, Y, X)
        else:
            g = v.reshape(B, X, Y, T).permute(0, 3, 2, 1) if tr else v.reshape(B, Y, X, T).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        if fy:
            g = g.flip(2)
        if fx:
            g = g.flip(3)
        return g

    def from_grid(self, g, lay):
        tmaj, tr, fy, fx = lay
        B = g.shape[0]
        if fy:
            g = g.flip(2)
        if fx:
            g = g.flip(3)
        if tmaj:

                g = g.transpose(2, 3)
        else:
            g = g.permute(0, 3, 2, 1) if tr else g.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        return g.reshape(B, -1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask.float()
        parts = self.obs_views(obs)
        if self.grid_ok:
            for o in self.offsets:
                v = m[:, o:o + self.n_place]
                for lay in LAYOUTS:
                    parts.append(self.to_grid(v, lay))
        else:
            parts.append(self.mask_embed(m).view(B, 8, self.Y, self.X))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, self.Y, 1).expand(B, 1, self.Y, self.X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, self.X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, self.X).expand(B, 1, self.Y, self.X)

        parts.append(xs)

        h = F.relu(h + self.r1(h))
        f = F.relu(h + self.r2(h))

        maps = self.hout(hh)

        done = self.done_head(g)
        if self.grid_ok:

        else:
            place = self.fb_out(maps.flatten(1))
            logits = torch.cat([place, done[:, :1]], 1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 2e-3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8,
          "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.002, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.85}

ATTN_BLOCKS = 1
HEADS = 4
FLAT = False
ACT_ATTN = False
PAD_MODE = "zeros"
MAX_SCHEMES = 16
EMB = 8
STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
HEADC = 32
GLOB = 64
FLATH = 128
AD = 32
COMPACT_KINDS = ["row", "col", "swap", "uni"]


def conv3(cin, cout):
    return nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, 3, padding=1, padding_mode=PAD_MODE)


def perm_scheme(K, Y, X, tmaj, tr, fy, fx):
    out = []
    for a in range(K * Y * X):
        if tmaj:
            k = a // (Y * X)
            r = a % (Y * X)
        else:
            k = a % K
            r = a // K
        if tr:
            x = r // Y
            y = r % Y
        else:
            y = r // X
            x = r % X
        if fy:
            y = Y - 1 - y
        if fx:
            x = X - 1 - x
        out.append(k * Y * X + y * X + x)
    return out


def compact_scheme(T, Y, X, fps, kind):
    mdy = max([f[0] for f in fps] + [1])
    mdx = max([f[1] for f in fps] + [1])
    out = []
    for t in range(T):
        if t < len(fps):
            dy, dx = fps[t]
        else:
            dy, dx = 1, 1
        if kind == "swap":
            dy, dx = dx, dy
        if kind == "uni":
            dy, dx = mdy, mdx
        ny = max(Y - dy + 1, 0)
        nx = max(X - dx + 1, 0)
        if kind == "col":
            for x in range(nx):
                for y in range(ny):
                    out.append(t * Y * X + y * X + x)
        else:
            for y in range(ny):
                for x in range(nx):
                    out.append(t * Y * X + y * X + x)
    return out


class SelfAttn(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(c, 3 * c)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(c, c)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(c, 2 * c)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(c)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(c)

    def forward(self, f):
        B, C, Y, X = f.shape
        t = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.n1(t)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        H = self.h
        d = C // H
        q = q.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(d), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, -1, C)
        t = t + self.proj(o)
        t = t + self.ff2(F.relu(self.ff1(self.n2(t))))
        return t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, Y, X)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        T = int(spec.n_types)
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.Y, self.X, self.C = Y, X, C
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.n_actions = int(spec.n_actions)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        schemes = []
        G = T
        if self.n_place > 0 and self.n_place % (Y * X) == 0:
            G = self.n_place // (Y * X)
            for tmaj in (True, False):
                for tr in (False, True):
                    for fy in (False, True):
                        for fx in (False, True):
                            s = perm_scheme(G, Y, X, tmaj, tr, fy, fx)
                            if s not in schemes:
                                schemes.append(s)
        else:
            for kind in COMPACT_KINDS:
                s = compact_scheme(T, Y, X, fps, kind)
                if len(s) == self.n_place and len(s) > 0 and s not in schemes:
                    schemes.append(s)
        schemes = schemes[:MAX_SCHEMES]
        self.G = G
        offs = []
        for o in [0, self.n_actions - self.n_place]:
            if o >= 0 and o + self.n_place <= self.n_actions and o not in offs:
                offs.append(o)
        if len(schemes) == 0 or len(offs) == 0:
            schemes = []
            offs = []
        self.offsets = offs
        self.n_s = len(schemes)
        if self.n_s > 0:
            self.register_buffer("idx", torch.tensor(schemes, dtype=torch.long))
        else:
            self.register_buffer("idx", torch.zeros(1, 1, dtype=torch.long))
        self.n_maps = self.n_s * len(self.offsets)

        in_ch = C + self.n_maps * G + 2

            self.mask_embed = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, EMB * Y * X)
            in_ch = in_ch + EMB
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
                                  nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.r1 = conv3(WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.r2 = conv3(WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.attn = nn.ModuleList([SelfAttn(WIDTH, HEADS) for _ in range(ATTN_BLOCKS)])
        self.hconv = conv3(WIDTH, HEADC)
        self.hskip = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HEADC, 1)
        if self.n_maps > 0:
            self.hout = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, self.n_maps * G, 1)
            self.scale = min(1.0, 2.0 / (self.n_maps ** 0.5))
        if self.use_dense:
            self.dense_red = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, 8, 1)
            self.dense_out = nn.Linear(8 * Y * X, self.n_actions)
        gin = 2 * WIDTH
        if FLAT:
            self.flat_obs = nn.Linear(C * Y * X, FLATH)
            self.flat_mask = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, FLATH)
            self.flat_mix = nn.Linear(FLATH, FLATH)
            self.flat_bc = nn.Linear(FLATH, WIDTH)
            self.flat_out = nn.Linear(FLATH, self.n_actions)
            gin = gin + FLATH
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(gin, GLOB), nn.ReLU())
        self.bias_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, self.n_actions)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GLOB, 1)
        if ACT_ATTN:
            self.aemb = nn.Embedding(self.n_actions, AD)
            self.amask = nn.Linear(1, AD)
            self.aglob = nn.Linear(GLOB, AD)
            self.akey = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, AD, 1)
            self.aval = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, AD, 1)
            self.aout1 = nn.Linear(AD, AD)
            self.aout2 = nn.Linear(AD, 1)
            self.register_buffer("aidx", torch.arange(self.n_actions, dtype=torch.long))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        G = self.G
        m = mask.float()
        parts = [obs]
        for o in self.offsets:
            mp = m[:, o:o + self.n_place]
            for k in range(self.n_s):
                g = m.new_zeros(B, G * Y * X).index_copy(1, self.idx[k], mp)
                parts.append(g.view(B, G, Y, X))
        if self.use_dense:
            parts.append(self.mask_embed(m).view(B, EMB, Y, X))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        parts.append(ys)
        parts.append(xs)
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(parts, 1))
        if FLAT:
            z = F.relu(self.flat_obs(obs.flatten(1)) + self.flat_mask(m))
            z = F.relu(self.flat_mix(z))
            h = h + self.flat_bc(z).view(B, -1, 1, 1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.r1(h))
        f = F.relu(h + self.r2(h))
        for blk in self.attn:
            f = blk(f)
        hh = F.relu(self.hconv(f) + self.hskip(f))
        pooled = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], 1)
        if FLAT:
            pooled = torch.cat([pooled, z], 1)
        gf = self.glob(pooled)
        logits = self.bias_head(gf)
        if self.n_maps > 0:
            maps = self.hout(hh)
            j = 0
            for o in self.offsets:
                acc = 0
                for k in range(self.n_s):
                    acc = acc + maps[:, j * G:(j + 1) * G].flatten(1).index_select(1, self.idx[k])
                    j += 1
                logits = logits + F.pad(acc * self.scale, (o, self.n_actions - self.n_place - o))
        if self.use_dense:
            logits = logits + self.dense_out(self.dense_red(hh).flatten(1))
        if FLAT:
            logits = logits + self.flat_out(z)
        if ACT_ATTN:
            q = self.aemb(self.aidx).unsqueeze(0) + self.amask(m.unsqueeze(-1)) + self.aglob(gf).unsqueeze(1)
            kk = self.akey(hh).flatten(2)
            vv = self.aval(hh).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
            att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, kk) / math.sqrt(AD), dim=-1)
            oo = torch.matmul(att, vv)
            logits = logits + self.aout2(F.relu(self.aout1(q + oo))).squeeze(-1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gf).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math

import torch.nn.functional as F

          "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

ATTN_BLOCKS = 1
HEADS = 4
FLAT = True
ACT_ATTN = False
PAD_MODE = "zeros"
MAX_SCHEMES = 16
EMB = 8
STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
HEADC = 32
GLOB = 64
FLATH = 128
AD = 32
COMPACT_KINDS = ["row", "col", "swap", "uni"]


def conv3(cin, cout):
    return nn.Conv2d(cin, cout, 3, padding=1, padding_mode=PAD_MODE)


def perm_scheme(K, Y, X, tmaj, tr, fy, fx):
    out = []
    for a in range(K * Y * X):
        if tmaj:
            k = a // (Y * X)
            r = a % (Y * X)
        else:
            k = a % K
            r = a // K
        if tr:
            x = r // Y
            y = r % Y
        else:
            y = r // X
            x = r % X
        if fy:
            y = Y - 1 - y
        if fx:
            x = X - 1 - x
        out.append(k * Y * X + y * X + x)
    return out


def compact_scheme(T, Y, X, fps, kind):
    mdy = max([f[0] for f in fps] + [1])
    mdx = max([f[1] for f in fps] + [1])
    out = []
    for t in range(T):
        if t < len(fps):
            dy, dx = fps[t]
        else:
            dy, dx = 1, 1
        if kind == "swap":
            dy, dx = dx, dy
        if kind == "uni":
            dy, dx = mdy, mdx
        ny = max(Y - dy + 1, 0)
        nx = max(X - dx + 1, 0)
        if kind == "col":
            for x in range(nx):
                for y in range(ny):
                    out.append(t * Y * X + y * X + x)
        else:
            for y in range(ny):
                for x in range(nx):
                    out.append(t * Y * X + y * X + x)
    return out


class SelfAttn(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(c, 3 * c)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(c, c)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(c, 2 * c)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(c)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(c)

    def forward(self, f):
        B, C, Y, X = f.shape
        t = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.n1(t)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        H = self.h
        d = C // H
        q = q.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, -1, H, d).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(d), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, -1, C)
        t = t + self.proj(o)
        t = t + self.ff2(F.relu(self.ff1(self.n2(t))))
        return t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, Y, X)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        T = int(spec.n_types)
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.Y, self.X, self.C = Y, X, C

        self.n_actions = int(spec.n_actions)

        G = T

                for tr in (False, True):

                            s = perm_scheme(G, Y, X, tmaj, tr, fy, fx)

        else:

                s = compact_scheme(T, Y, X, fps, kind)
                if len(s) == self.n_place and len(s) > 0 and s not in schemes:
                    schemes.append(s)
        schemes = schemes[:MAX_SCHEMES]
        self.G = G
        offs = []
        for o in [0, self.n_actions - self.n_place]:
            if o >= 0 and o + self.n_place <= self.n_actions and o not in offs:
                offs.append(o)
        if len(schemes) == 0 or len(offs) == 0:
            schemes = []
            offs = []
        self.offsets = offs
        self.n_s = len(schemes)
        if self.n_s > 0:
            self.register_buffer("idx", torch.tensor(schemes, dtype=torch.long))
        else:

        self.attn = nn.ModuleList([SelfAttn(WIDTH, HEADS) for _ in range(ATTN_BLOCKS)])

            self.scale = min(1.0, 2.0 / (self.n_maps ** 0.5))
        if self.use_dense:

        gin = 2 * WIDTH
        if FLAT:

            self.flat_mask = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, FLATH)
            self.flat_mix = nn.Linear(FLATH, FLATH)
            self.flat_bc = nn.Linear(FLATH, WIDTH)
            self.flat_out = nn.Linear(FLATH, self.n_actions)

            self.aglob = nn.Linear(GLOB, AD)

            self.aval = nn.Conv2d(HEADC, AD, 1)
            self.aout1 = nn.Linear(AD, AD)
            self.aout2 = nn.Linear(AD, 1)
            self.register_buffer("aidx", torch.arange(self.n_actions, dtype=torch.long))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        G = self.G
        m = mask.float()
        parts = [obs]
        for o in self.offsets:
            mp = m[:, o:o + self.n_place]
            for k in range(self.n_s):
                g = m.new_zeros(B, G * Y * X).index_copy(1, self.idx[k], mp)
                parts.append(g.view(B, G, Y, X))
        if self.use_dense:
            parts.append(self.mask_embed(m).view(B, EMB, Y, X))
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        parts.append(ys)
        parts.append(xs)
        h = self.stem(torch.cat(parts, 1))
        if FLAT:
            z = F.relu(self.flat_obs(obs.flatten(1)) + self.flat_mask(m))
            z = F.relu(self.flat_mix(z))
            h = h + self.flat_bc(z).view(B, -1, 1, 1)
        h = F.relu(h + self.r1(h))
        f = F.relu(h + self.r2(h))
        for blk in self.attn:
            f = blk(f)
        hh = F.relu(self.hconv(f) + self.hskip(f))
        pooled = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], 1)
        if FLAT:

        gf = self.glob(pooled)
        logits = self.bias_head(gf)
        if self.n_maps > 0:
            maps = self.hout(hh)

                acc = 0
                for k in range(self.n_s):
                    acc = acc + maps[:, j * G:(j + 1) * G].flatten(1).index_select(1, self.idx[k])
                    j += 1
                logits = logits + F.pad(acc * self.scale, (o, self.n_actions - self.n_place - o))
        if self.use_dense:
            logits = logits + self.dense_out(self.dense_red(hh).flatten(1))
        if FLAT:
            logits = logits + self.flat_out(z)
        if ACT_ATTN:
            q = self.aemb(self.aidx).unsqueeze(0) + self.amask(m.unsqueeze(-1)) + self.aglob(gf).unsqueeze(1)
            kk = self.akey(hh).flatten(2)
            vv = self.aval(hh).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
            att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, kk) / math.sqrt(AD), dim=-1)
            oo = torch.matmul(att, vv)
            logits = logits + self.aout2(F.relu(self.aout1(q + oo))).squeeze(-1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gf).squeeze(1)

That rules out the following, at least in the forms we tried: the 16 grid-symmetry and type-order layouts, DONE at index 0 or last, permuted obs channels (a 1x1 stem absorbs these), obs transposed, flipped or read channel-last, footprints or anchors off by up to 2 cells (5x5 head), compact action counts with in-grid anchors, non-local dynamics (global context), and recipe changes (1 epoch, longer horizon). One gap remains. When n_place ≠ T·Y·X, every earlier net fell back to slow dense heads, so action spaces like n_place = K·Y·X with K ≠ n_types were never hedged properly. Examples are a chosen landing layer (no drop, K = T·Z) or extra rotations. Two other untested deviations: obs values on a different scale (raw heights or counts, not normalised to 0-1), and dynamics that per-layer reasoning handles better than column summaries. Every candidate this round builds on a generic K-channel layout hedge, which reduces to the old hedge when K = T.
analyses.4: After 18 trials every dev and training score is 0, so no candidate has produced a signal. These changes are ruled out as fixes: the 16 action layouts (8 grid symmetries × type-major or type-minor order); DONE at index 0 or at the end, plus a free per-action bias; K = n_place/(Y·X) and compact action counts; dense heads; channel-last obs views; 5x5 heads; input normalisation; per-layer trunks; global context; and longer horizons or 1 PPO epoch. A 1x1 stem already absorbs any obs channel permutation. Untested so far: obs scrambled spatially relative to the grid, an action-to-cell mapping that no simple layout describes, wrap-around (torus) edges, non-local links between obs and mask beyond the conv receptive field, and sparse or distorted shaping rewards where only the exact-build bonus counts. In this final round each candidate keeps the generic-K hedge and adds one new flexible, layout-free component at full scale. Two of them combine components and pair them with recipes for exploration or more samples.
